  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. This Lariat model comes equipped with a host of premium features, including a twin panel moonroof, 10-speed automatic transmission, and the Luxury Package that adds luxury touches like a Sony audio system, rain-sensing wipers, and a power tilt/telescoping steering column. The Lariat Chrome Appearance Package further enhances the exterior with chrome accents and 20-inch chrome-like wheels.

Inside, the cabin is outfitted in premium leather and offers heated and cooled front seats, a heated steering wheel, and a voice-activated navigation system. The Trailer Tow Package adds essential towing capabilities, while the 36-gallon extended range fuel tank ensures you can go the distance.

Whether you're hauling the family or towing your toys, this 2017 Ford F-150 Lariat is ready to handle it all with power, capability, and uncompromising luxury.

2017 Ford F-150 SuperCrew Cab XL Pickup 4D 5 1/2 ft 5.0 V8 4WD Vehicle DescriptionIntroductionThe 2017 Ford F-150 SuperCrew XL 5.0 V8 4WD is a full-size pickup truck built for drivers who want real V8 power, proven durability, and everyday practicality. As part of the legendary F-Series lineup, the F-150 has earned its reputation as one of the toughest and most dependable trucks on the road. Equipped with the highly respected 5.0L V8 engine and 4WD capability, this truck delivers the kind of strength and confidence truck buyers look for when they need serious performance and long-term reliability.The SuperCrew configuration adds full-size rear seating and four full doors, making it perfect not only for work but also for family use and everyday driving. Whether you're towing, hauling equipment, driving in rough weather, or simply looking for a truck with strong road presence and capability, this F-150 is designed to handle it all with ease.Performance
  • Engine: 5.0-liter V8
  • Horsepower: 385 hp
  • Torque: 387 lb-ft
  • Transmission: 6-speed automatic transmission
  • Drivetrain: 4WD (Four-Wheel Drive)
  • Fuel Economy: ~15 MPG city/~21 MPG highway
  • Towing Capacity: Up to ~10,000 lbs (properly equipped)
Under the hood, this F-150 is powered by Ford s legendary 5.0L V8 engine producing 385 horsepower and 387 lb-ft of torque, delivering strong acceleration, excellent towing power, and the classic V8 sound and feel many truck buyers prefer.Unlike smaller turbocharged engines, the naturally aspirated V8 provides immediate and consistent power delivery, making it especially dependable for towing, hauling, and long-term durability. The 6-speed automatic transmission shifts smoothly and is built to handle demanding use while still maintaining a comfortable driving experience.The 4WD system gives the truck added traction and confidence in rain, snow, mud, or rough terrain, making it a great option for drivers who need capability year-round. Despite its size and strength, the F-150 still delivers a surprisingly smooth and controlled ride, thanks to Ford s well-tuned suspension and lightweight military-grade aluminum-alloy body design.Interior & Comfort
  • Seating Capacity: Up to 6 passengers
  • Spacious SuperCrew full-size cabin
  • Durable cloth seating
  • Large rear seating area
  • Air conditioning
  • Fold-up rear seats for additional storage
  • Multiple interior storage compartments
Inside, the SuperCrew cabin is one of the strongest features of this truck. The rear seating area offers impressive legroom, allowing adults to comfortably ride in the back without feeling cramped. Whether you're transporting family, coworkers, or passengers on long trips, the cabin provides the space and practicality that many smaller trucks simply can t match.The interior is built with durability in mind while still remaining comfortable for everyday driving. Controls are straightforward and easy to use, creating a practical and driver-friendly layout. There s also plenty of interior storage space for tools, equipment, or personal items, making this truck highly functional for both work and daily life.Technology & Infotainment
  • Ford infotainment/audio system
  • Bluetooth hands-free calling
  • USB and auxiliary connectivity
  • Steering wheel-mounted controls
  • Backup camera availability
  • Available SYNC system
The F-150 XL offers practical technology features designed to improve convenience without overcomplicating the driving experience. Bluetooth connectivity allows for hands-free communication and streaming, while available SYNC technology helps keep your phone and media easily accessible.Everything is designed around functionality and ease of use, which is exactly what most truck owners appreciate in a dependable daily driver or work vehicle.Dimensions & Capability
  • Bed Length: 5.5-foot short bed
  • Wheelbase: ~145 inches
  • Seating: Up to 6 passengers
  • Payload Capacity: Up to ~2,000 lbs
  • Towing Capacity: Up to ~10,000 lbs (properly equipped)
The 5.5-foot bed offers a perfect balance between cargo space and maneuverability. It provides plenty of room for tools, equipment, materials, or recreational gear while still being easier to park and drive than longer-bed models.This truck is designed to handle real work, whether that means towing trailers, hauling materials, or handling weekend projects. The strong payload and towing capabilities make it one of the most versatile trucks in its class.Exterior Features
  • Bold Ford truck styling
  • SuperCrew 4-door cab design
  • Durable aluminum-alloy body construction
  • Daytime running lights
  • Rugged 4WD stance
  • Strong and aggressive front-end design
The exterior of the 2017 F-150 combines rugged durability with modern styling. Its bold front grille, high stance, and muscular body lines give it a commanding road presence, while the aluminum-alloy body helps improve efficiency and long-term durability.The SuperCrew body style also adds a more upscale and balanced appearance, making this truck equally suited for work environments and personal driving.Safety & Driver Assistance
  • Stability and traction control
  • Trailer sway control
  • Anti-lock braking system (ABS)
  • Multiple airbags
  • Tire pressure monitoring system
  • Available rearview camera
Safety features in the F-150 are designed to help maintain control and stability, especially while towing or driving in difficult conditions. Trailer sway control helps improve towing confidence, while traction and stability systems work together to keep the truck planted and predictable on the road.Ford engineered the F-150 to be both strong and dependable, helping provide peace of mind whether you're on the highway, job site, or back roads.Highlights
  • Powerful 5.0L V8 engine with 385 HP
  • Proven V8 reliability and durability
  • 4WD capability for all-weather confidence
  • Spacious SuperCrew full-size cabin
  • Strong towing and hauling capability
  • Smooth ride quality for a full-size truck
  • Lightweight aluminum-alloy body construction
  • Excellent truck for both work and personal use
  • One of the most trusted trucks on the road
SummaryThe 2017 Ford F-150 SuperCrew Cab XL 5.0 V8 4WD is a truck built to deliver real capability, reliability, and everyday usability. With its legendary 5.0L V8 engine, strong towing power, and spacious SuperCrew cabin, it offers everything most truck buyers are looking for in a full-size pickup.Whether you need a dependable work truck, a capable towing vehicle, or simply a comfortable and powerful daily driver, this F-150 stands out as an excellent choice. It s tough, versatile, and built to last making it one of the best all-around trucks in its class.
